table-2000-2095.title: Community BS month-length table, BS 2000-2095
table-2000-2095.note: Identical to nepali-datetime 1.0.8.5 for every shipped year except 2087 (see below); identical to nepali-date-converter 3.4.0 and nepali-date-library 1.1.15 on 2078-2083 (legacy public-benchmark/results/competitor-comparison.md). Anchored 2082-01-01 BS = 2025-04-14 AD. Legacy rows 2096-2099 are not shipped: 2096 sums to 364 days; 2097/2099 disagree between sources.

table-provisional.title: Same table, years 2084-2095
table-provisional.note: Community table for BS 2084–2095, not independently established as official. Future month lengths may change. BS 2087 uses the 366-day nepali-datetime row.
